endpoints.description: Toggle or set the VIP status of a user (Admin only).

requestBody.is_vip: boolean (optional, if omitted toggles current status)

businessRules: VIP Access Gatekeeping: Access to VIP Lounge routes and voting endpoints is strictly limited to users with is_vip == true.
Single & Immutable Vote: 1 User = 1 Vote per poll enforced at DB level (UNIQUE index on poll_id, user_id). Votes cannot be edited or revoked.
Voting Progress Privacy: Voting percentage bars and counts are hidden until after the vote is cast.
